whenToUse: Showing stores, field jobs or vehicles as markers without a tile provider or API key.
A list and map whose selection stays in sync.
avoidWhen: Opening hours plus a single location card — use map-hours.
Value density across a grid — use heatmap.
a11y: Pins are a labelled group with aria-pressed selection; arrow keys move to the nearest pin and Escape clears.
Always offer the synced list as a non-visual alternative.
